unitTitle: A2 capstone: handle a changing week
title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 12: A2 capstone: handle a changing week

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Nouvel horaire : la réunion est jeudi. Le groupe est au centre après le cours.
steps.question: When will the group meet?
steps.explain: The meeting is moved to Thursday; the group meets after class.

steps.fr: Il pleuvait quand le bus est arrivé. J'ai pris le nouvel itinéraire et j'ai lu l'avis.
steps.question: What did the speaker do after the bus arrived?
options: Took a new route and read the notice
steps.explain: The recording says the speaker took a new route and read the notice.

steps.fr: La deuxième option est plus simple, mais elle est plus longue. Je vais y aller après le cours.
steps.question: What is true about the second option?
options: It is shorter but more difficult
steps.explain: The speaker says it is simpler but longer.

steps.fr: Pourriez-vous confirmer le point de départ ? Je voudrais le noter avant de partir.
steps.question: What does the speaker want to confirm?
steps.explain: The request is to confirm the starting point.

steps.fr: Après le test blanc, j'ai une erreur fréquente dans mes notes. Je vais la revoir demain.
steps.question: When will the speaker review the error?
steps.explain: The speaker says they will review it tomorrow.
